text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners quickly, so I should judge each position by its outlook and target allocation—not sell just to lock in a gain.","A falling account value is a reminder to manage risk deliberately; I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me in a position without a sound reason.","Doing nothing can be reasonable, but I should review my holdings periodically and make a change when the evidence or my plan calls for it."]}
